messages.content: Ray was in possession of 25 lollipops. He decided to hold onto 5 of them and distributed the rest evenly among his four buddies. How many lollipops did each buddy get?

content.text:
Ray started with 25 lollipops and kept 5, so he had 25 - 5 = **20 lollipops** to distribute.

Dividing evenly among his 4 buddies: 20 ÷ 4 = **5 lollipops** each.
